alt: Amazon Kindle 2026 e-readers in four colors — black, gold, rose, and denim — displayed together, showing the new bezel-free flush-glass design that introduced the light bleed issue on the base model
story: Amazon's new 2026 Kindle eliminated the physical bezel for a sleek flush-glass design, but the edge lighting bleeds through the glass in dark mode, creating a bright glowing ring along all four edges; when users complained, Amazon's official response was that this was 'expected' to achieve a 'color bezel' — meaning Amazon's solution for the bezel-free design was to accidentally create a bezel made of light.
why_funny: Amazon's design goal was to remove the bezel; the design they shipped created one out of light bleed; and Amazon's official position is that a glowing fake bezel was always the plan.
